categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies the behavior and output of the `analyzepsbt` RPC in src/node/psbt.cpp
categories.rationale: Fixes incorrect RPC output where `analyzepsbt` reports a negative fee and advises downstream roles like updater or signer when outputs exceed inputs. The RPC now correctly marks the transaction as invalid with an error message and sets the next role to creator.
